verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs describe Dunning Management, which controls when retries occur on failed payments. They also name Intelligent Retries as an involuntary-churn tool and offer an 'optimized dunning' standalone retry engine that manages the full recovery lifecycle, with up to 50 targeted dunning campaigns on higher plans. Together these clearly cover automatic, optimized retry of failed renewals. Missing for 10: detail on how the ML or optimized retry cadence works, any recovery-rate metrics or reporting showing measurable churn reduction, and independent hands-on corroboration of retry performance.
